newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Lower House passes 97/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Japan Lower House passes 97/98 budget.

text.p: The Lower House of Japan's parliament on Wednesday approved a state budget totalling 77.39 trillion yen for the fiscal year starting on April 1, overriding objections from opposition party members.
Although the budget will now be sent to the Upper House for approval, the Lower House has authority over the budget and passage of the measure is virtually assured.
This will allow the state budget to be implemented from the start of the new fiscal year on April 1, which government officials have said is essential to put Japan's economy on a firm recovery track.

The budget has been the subject of criticism by financial markets and the general public because it features tax increases and the possibility of more spending to build new lines for Shinkansen bullet trains in the future.
Opposition parties had demanded that the government cut spending and reverse a decision to halt special income tax cuts.
